title: Avila Core Bound Plan v0.1 draft
description: The strict, content-identified reading of `avila-core run --plan`: per step, the decision the run could actually take against the operator supplies given. `execute` requires the declared capability's bytes to verify at the supplied path and every required environment key to be valued; anything short is `blocked` with named reasons. Deriving a bound plan hashes bytes and never executes; only the normal run path executes or reuses.

status.description: ready: every declared step is reuse_committed or execute. blocked: at least one step is blocked on an operator supply. refused: at least one step is refused outright. unavailable: planning never produced an execution section.

changes.description: For execute: the SC-12 change classes that defeated committed-receipt reuse.

blockers.description: Named reasons a blocked step cannot run — capability_not_supplied, capability_missing, capability_mismatch, inputs_unverified, environment_not_supplied — or the finding codes a refused step carries.

capability_source.description: Where the resolved executable came from: an explicit --capability supply, or a --capability-dir scan matched on the pinned executable_sha256. A kind, not a path, so the plan's identity stays portable.

estimated_duration_ms.description: The duration the step's committed receipt last recorded — an estimate from recorded evidence inside the package, deterministic for a given package identity, not a prediction model.

impactReport.description: The SC-12.6 change analysis over the plan's decisions: every invalidated node with the condemning edge path that carried the change to it, the permitted reuse and its authority, the minimal rerun subgraph, and a labeled cost estimate.

invalidated.description: Steps whose committed evidence this run's changes invalidate — every step a supplied input reaches through the compiled bindings.

condemned_by.description: The binding edges carrying invalidation into this step — `input:<id> -> <step>.<slot>` or `step:<src>/<src_slot> -> <step>.<slot>`. Empty when the step's own change records are the origin.

reused.description: Steps permitted to reuse committed evidence and the authority they reuse under — `deterministic_memo` for an identical invocation digest over byte-identical bound inputs.

rerun_subgraph.description: The minimal set of steps that must execute — every invalidated node plus every step whose own change records defeat reuse, in compiled workflow order.

estimated_duration_ms.description: The sum of the rerun subgraph's recorded estimated_duration_ms, reported only when every rerun step carries one.

unestimated_steps.description: Rerun steps with no committed receipt duration; while nonzero the estimate is absent or partial.
